From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@payguard.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Intake: Private / VPC demo request — PayGuard (regulated payments)

Hi Neha,

Thanks — we signed up on the self-serve flow yesterday and indicated that we need a demo for a Private/VPC deployment. I'm leading the infrastructure intake for PayGuard; Tim (cc'd below) is our platform engineer and will join the technical session.

High-level asks:
- We want a technical walkthrough focused on network topology, encryption/key management, and data isolation (air-gapped option if available).
- Please share an SOC 2 summary and a network diagram template we can use to align with our netsec team.
- We prefer a 60-minute technical intake + Q&A.

Available windows (PST): Tue 5/4 10:00-12:00, Wed 5/5 14:00-17:00, or Thu 5/6 morning. Do any of those work for Redwood?

Attendees from our side: Elena Martinez (Infra), Tim O'Neill (Platform), Sarah Liu (Legal, may join for compliance questions).

Can you confirm next steps and what pre-read we should review?

Best,
Elena
Infrastructure Lead | PayGuard Systems
[Attachment: initial_signup_receipt.txt]
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@payguard.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: Private / VPC demo request — PayGuard (regulated payments)

Hi Elena — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood. Thanks for the details.

Short answer: yes, we can run a 60-minute technical intake focused on VPC/private deployment, KMS/HSM integrations, and network isolation patterns. We've helped several payments customers with similar constraints. To make the session productive, we'll share a short SOC 2 summary and a network template ahead of time.

Proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue 5/4 10:30-11:30 (tight, but doable)
- Wed 5/5 15:00-16:00 (recommended)
- Thu 5/6 09:00-10:00 (if you prefer morning)

I'll attach two quick artifacts below. Rishi (cc) will run the demo and cover runtime/topology; Priyom (cc) will cover security controls, KMS patterns, and the mutual action plan (MAP).

Attachments:
- SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (short summary PDF)
- redwood_network_template.png (network diagram template)

If you confirm a slot, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda + MAP template (editable). Also: do you have any strict IP allowlist ranges or firewall constraints we should be aware of for a test endpoint?

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise SDR Manager | Redwood Inference

Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping in Rishi and Priyom. Wed 5/5 15:00-16:00 PST works best for our team. Please include Sarah from Legal if possible (sarah.liu@payguard.com).

Quick notes for the pre-read:
- We will share a recent network audit.
- Our KMS is AWS KMS with a pending HSM evaluation — interested in examples of HSM or external KMS integrations.
- Compliance: SOC2 + PCI scope considerations.

Can you also share the mutual action plan before the meeting so our procurement team can review? If you have a DocuSign or procurement intake link we can use, send it along.

Thanks — Elena

1) 5m — Introductions & goals
2) 25m — Architecture & deployment options (Rishi)
3) 20m — Security controls, KMS/HSM patterns, audit logs (Priyom)
4) 10m — Next steps & MAP review

Pre-reads / artifacts attached:
- PayGuard_MAP.xlsx (editable MAP template for procurement / timelines)
- SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (same as earlier)
- redwood_network_template.png

Related links: HubSpot record and MAP folder (see links below). We'll send a follow-up with action owners mapped in the MAP after the call.

Rishi / Priyom — can you both join and be prepared to: (a) show a sample VPC topology that matches firewall allowlist steps, and (b) review KMS/HSM integration options (Priyom — please bring any customer examples or notes on HSM partners).

Elena / Tim / Sarah — if there are any additional stakeholders who should be on the invite, reply-all and we'll add them.

Best,
Neha
